claim: Drifting matter in the air — the standard anime device for filling dead space and giving a still something that can move once it hits i2v. Petals and embers are mood statements as much as physics: one says tenderness, the other says something is burning.
method: identical subject sentence and seed in every panel; only the option clause changes. panels marked control render the untouched subject, because SDXL cannot express absence.

panels.clause: dust particles, floating dust, motes in the air
pollen, floating pollen, yellow specks in the air
falling petals, cherry blossom petals, petals in the air
falling ash, ash particles, grey flakes drifting
embers, floating embers, glowing sparks in the air
falling snow, snowflakes in the air
falling leaves, leaves in the wind, drifting foliage
fireflies, glowing insects, points of light in the air
steam, rising steam, vapour in the air
spores, floating spores, glowing motes drifting
